post.caption: Tutankhamun's gold funeral mask weighs about 10 kilograms, or 22 pounds, and a protective spell from the Book of the Dead, chapter 151, is written on its back. It has quartz and obsidian eyes, lapis lazuli brows and a cobra and a vulture for Lower and Upper Egypt. Howard Carter's team found the tomb in November 1922, and the mask came into view on October 28, 1925, when the coffin lid was lifted.
